controls: Update available / Download / Install on restart / Later / Release notes (UpdateUI.tsx + store/updates.ts)
defaultChannel: stable (DEFAULT_CONFIG.channel; channels nightly/dev/alpha/beta/stable/enterprise exist in types but production serves stable)
endpoint: GET {AETHEROS_UPDATE_BASE_URL}/updates/{platform}/{arch}/{channel} (default base https://releases.aetheros.com; AETHEROS_UPDATE_BASE_URL override for staging/local harness)
fix: this execution: was https://updates.aetheros.com/api/v1/{platform}/{arch}/{channel} (unregistered host, missing /updates prefix); now matches createUpdateRequestHandler routes in services/update/update-server.ts
intrusiveness: non-blocking notify; no forced install; metered-network policy wifi-only default
manifest: signed UpdateManifest (RSA-SHA256 canonical JSON); verifyManifest() enforces product, protocolVersion, channel, platform/arch artifact presence, semver validity
noDowngrade: compareVersions() < 0 required for update-available; downgrade refused unless allowDowngrade explicitly set (DOWNGRADE_FORBIDDEN)
secretsInApp: none (grep PASS: no GH_TOKEN/GITHUB_TOKEN/AWS_/R2_TOKEN/PRIVATE_KEY/api.github.com in src/updater/ or electron/)
semver: numeric major/minor/patch compare + semver prerelease precedence; 1.0.10 > 1.0.9 (integer parse, not lexicographic)
ux: respects existing UpdateUI/store surfaces; no new popup system introduced
verification: sha256 digest + RSA artifact signature via verifyArtifactSignature(); failure => DO NOT INSTALL (FAILED state, no silent untrusted update)
